title: Acceptance criteria
description: Structured contract produced by Intake. QA checks coverage against this. Lightweight for fast-path tasks, full for substantial work. For a greenfield build delivered as MULTIPLE bounded runs, this file is the criteria for THIS RUN's phase, and `phase` + `engagement_criteria` name the phase and point at the engagement-wide master it was drawn from. firm-traceability-check validates the QA verdict's coverage and the traceability matrix in BOTH directions against this file, so a run whose file carries the whole engagement's criteria while the run delivers one phase cannot pass -- and will not discover that until the Final gate.

test_evidence_required.description: which test types must show evidence, e.g. ['unit','integration']

phase.description: OPTIONAL. The phase this run delivers, when a greenfield build is decomposed into multiple bounded runs (see the greenfield_build profile in agent-firm/policy/execution-budget.yaml and the Architect's run-phasing plan). Present means `criteria` below is the PHASE's subset, not the engagement's whole set. Absent means this run delivers everything in `criteria`.

engagement_criteria.description: OPTIONAL, and REQUIRED IN PRACTICE whenever `phase` is set: the run-relative path to the engagement-wide criteria file this phase was drawn from, preserved verbatim so nothing is silently dropped. Conventionally 01-acceptance-criteria.engagement.yaml. A reader must be able to see the criteria this run did NOT take on, and which later phase owns them.
